name: Making A Difference
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively make a difference by doing good whenever it is within their power, reflecting God's justice, mercy, and humility as shown in Micah 6:8 and Proverbs 3:27. Christians are called to be the 'salt of the earth,' preserving and influencing the world positively (Matthew 5:13), and to demonstrate their faith through compassionate actions such as feeding the hungry and welcoming strangers, as illustrated in Matthew 25:34-35. Additionally, the Great Commission in Mark 16:15 emphasizes the responsibility to proclaim the gospel to all people, underscoring that making a difference involves both practical service and sharing the message of Christ.
